DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人の写真を仕事の掲示物に使いたいです。写真を送ってもらっただけで使ってよいのか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人から送られた写真を仕事の掲示物に使いたいので、送付だけで利用してよいのか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to use an acquaintance's photo on a work notice. I want to ask whether receiving the photo from them is enough to allow me to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may use a photo an acquaintance sent you on a work notice simply because they sent it to you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真を使う目的は知人に伝えましたか。ほかの方も写っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you told your acquaintance what you want to use the photo for? Are there other people in it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 個人で見るために送ってもらいました。数人の顔も写っていて、仕事で使う話はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個人で見るために受け取った写真に数人の顔が写り、仕事で使うことはまだ話していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They sent it to me for personal viewing. Several people's faces are in it, and I have not discussed using it for work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you received the photo for personal viewing, that several people's faces are visible, and that you have not yet discussed work use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送付されたことと、掲示への了承は同じではありません。関係者に目的を説明して確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sending a photo and agreeing to its display are not the same thing. Explain your intended purpose to those involved and check with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 撮った知人がよいと言っても、写った人の希望まで決めたとは考えません。まず仕事で使うことを知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影者の了承だけで写った人の希望まで決まったとは考えず、仕事で使う目的を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if the acquaintance who took it agrees, I will not assume that decides the wishes of the people pictured. First, I will tell them I want to use it for work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not assume the photographer's agreement settles the wishes of the people pictured and that you will explain your intended work use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 掲載する範囲や掲示場所も伝えると確認しやすいですね。すでに掲示しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It will be easier to check if you also explain how much of the photo you will publish and where the notice will be displayed. Have you put it up already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。会社には確認が済んでいないと伝え、急ぎなら別の画像を用意する相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まだ掲示しておらず、会社に確認未了と知らせ、急ぎなら別の画像を用意する相談をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I will tell my company that confirmation is still pending and discuss preparing a different image if it is urgent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not displayed it yet, will tell your company confirmation is pending, and will discuss preparing another image if it is urgent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わからないまま掲載せず、必要に応じて詳しい相談先も利用してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not publish it while the situation is unclear. Please also use a specialist advice service if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮影者と写った人への確認を分けます。了承の範囲がわかるまで、仕事の掲示物には載せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影者と写った人への確認を分け、了承の範囲が分かるまで仕事の掲示物には使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check separately with the photographer and the people pictured. I will not use it on the work notice until I know the scope of their agreement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check separately with the photographer and the people pictured, and will not use the photo on the work notice until the scope of agreement is clear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。目的と利用範囲を整理してご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please organize your intended purpose and scope of use before seeking advice. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with sending something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 封筒の差出人住所が前の家です。相手の住所は合っていますが、このまま送る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 差出人欄が旧住所の封筒を、宛先は正しくても発送前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sender's address on this envelope is my previous home. The recipient's address is correct, but I want to check before sending it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that although the recipient's address is correct, you want to check the envelope before sending it because the sender's field has your old address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の住所では、今もご自身が郵便を受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you still receive your own mail at the old address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう退居しています。宛先が正しければ差出人欄は関係ないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所は退居済みで、宛先が正しければ差出人欄は関係ないと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have already moved out. I thought the sender's field did not matter as long as the recipient's address was correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have moved out of the old address and thought the sender's field did not matter if the recipient's address was correct. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届かず戻る場合のことも考え、現在連絡できる情報で準備しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us prepare it with information where you can currently be reached, considering that it might be returned if it cannot be delivered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の住所を書き直します。古い住所の上に小さく書き足すより、新しい封筒に読みやすく書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読みづらい追記をせず、新しい封筒に現在の住所を読みやすく書き直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will rewrite it with my current address. Rather than adding small writing over the old address, I would like to write it clearly on a new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to rewrite your current address clearly on a new envelope instead of making an addition that is hard to read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先と差出人を取り違えずに書いてください。中の書類にも住所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not mix up the recipient and sender fields. Is there an address on the documents inside too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。書類も前の住所なので、提出先が何を求めるか確認してから直します。封筒だけ変えて済ませません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中の書類も旧住所なので、提出先の指定を確認してから直し、封筒だけの変更で済ませないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The documents also have my old address, so I will check what the receiving office requires before correcting them. I will not just change the envelope and consider it done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the documents inside also have your old address, so you will check the receiving office's requirements before correcting them rather than only changing the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類の指定は提出先に確かめてください。準備が整ったら発送できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the document requirements with the receiving office. You can send it once everything is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類の住所欄を提出先へ聞き、新しい封筒に宛先と今の差出人情報を書いて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類の住所欄を提出先に確認し、新しい封筒に正しい宛先と現在の差出人情報を書いて持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the receiving office about the documents' address field, then bring a new envelope with the recipient's address and my current sender information written on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the documents' address field with the receiving office, then bring a new envelope with the correct recipient address and your current sender information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認後にお持ちください。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it after checking. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座のご利用で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you use your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 暗証番号が思い出せません。家族が覚えているかもしれないので、電話で伝えてもらってよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 暗証番号を忘れ、家族が覚えているかもしれないので電話で教えてもらってよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot remember my PIN. A family member might remember it, so I would like to ask whether I can have them tell me over the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have forgotten your PIN and want to ask whether a family member who might remember it can tell you over the phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号をこちらや周囲の方へ伝えないでください。必要な確認方法を担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not tell the number to us or to anyone around you. The person in charge will explain the necessary verification process.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。電話をスピーカーにして聞こうとしていましたが、番号を周りへ聞かせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スピーカーで聞こうとしていたが、番号を周囲に聞かせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I was about to use speakerphone to hear it, but I will not let people around me hear the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you were going to use speakerphone but will not let people around you hear the number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の手続きを確認しましょう。何度も思い当たる番号を入力していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the procedure for you as the account holder. Have you been entering possible numbers repeatedly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日はまだ入力していません。思いつく番号を次々試すより、忘れた時の手続きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日はまだ入力しておらず、思いつく番号を次々試さず忘れた場合の手続きを知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not entered any today. Rather than trying every number that comes to mind, I would like to ask about the procedure for a forgotten PIN.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not entered a number today and want to know the forgotten-PIN procedure rather than trying possible numbers one after another. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。本人確認に必要な物は案内に沿って確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will connect you with the person in charge. Please follow the instructions to check what is needed to verify your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に私の代わりに操作させず、自分で手続きをします。本人確認書類はこのかばんにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に代わりに操作してもらわず自分で手続きをし、本人確認書類を持参していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will handle the procedure myself rather than have my family operate it for me. My identification documents are in this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will handle the procedure yourself rather than have your family operate it for you, and that you have brought identification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類は担当へ提示してください。番号を記した物があっても、この場所で広げないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the documents to the person in charge. Even if you have something with the number written on it, please do not open it up here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当へ忘れたと伝え、必要な手続きを聞きます。家族へ番号を電話で言わせたり、ここで公開したりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当者に暗証番号を忘れたと説明して手続きを聞き、家族に電話で言わせたり周囲に公開したりしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell the person in charge that I have forgotten it and ask what procedure is required. I will not have my family say the number over the phone or reveal it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain to the person in charge that you forgot your PIN and ask about the procedure, without having your family say it over the phone or revealing it to others. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お買い物で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同居人と別々に品物を選びました。同じ物を買いすぎないよう、二つのかごを一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居人と別々に選んだ商品の買いすぎを防ぐため、二つのかごを一緒に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My housemate and I chose items separately. I would like to check our two baskets together so we do not buy too much of the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the two baskets together to avoid buying too much after you and your housemate selected items separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの品が重なっていますか。リストには必要な数量がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which items overlap? Does your list show the quantities you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 米が両方にあります。リストは一袋ですが、各自一袋ずつ取ればよいと二人とも思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 米は共用で一袋の予定だったが、それぞれが一袋ずつ取ってしまったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is rice in both baskets. The list says one bag, but we both thought we should each take one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you planned to buy one bag of rice to share, but each of you took a bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二人で一袋の予定だったのですね。ほかにも数量が重なった品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You planned on one bag between the two of you, then. Are there any other items where the quantities overlap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 牛乳も二本ありますが、こちらは二本必要です。同じ品が二つあるだけで、全部片方を戻すのは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 牛乳は二本必要なので、同じ品が二つあるだけで全て片方を戻すわけではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: We also have two cartons of milk, but we need two of those. It would not be right to put one of every duplicate back just because there are two of the same product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you need two cartons of milk, so you will not put one of every item back merely because there are two of the same product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要数量に合わせて整理しましょう。会計は二つに分ける予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us organize them according to the quantities you need. Are you planning two separate payments?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家の共用品は一緒に払います。私だけのお菓子は別にして、同居人へ共用品として請求しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共用品は一緒に払い、自分だけのお菓子は別にして共用品として同居人に請求しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will pay together for shared household items. I will keep my own snacks separate and will not charge my housemate for them as shared items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay together for shared items, keep your personal snacks separate, and not charge your housemate for those as shared items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かごを分けておけば確認しやすいですね。戻す品は状態を確認して売場へ戻しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Separating the baskets will make it easier to check. Check the condition of items you are returning and put them back in the sales area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 米は一袋、牛乳は二本を共用会計にします。自分のお菓子は別のかごにし、合計も分けて確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 共用会計の米は一袋、牛乳は二本にし、自分のお菓子は別のかごと会計で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will pay for one bag of rice and two cartons of milk as shared items. I will put my snacks in a separate basket and check the totals separately too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the shared payment will cover one bag of rice and two cartons of milk, while your snacks will be checked in a separate basket and payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。整理ができましたらレジへお進みください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please proceed to the checkout once you have sorted everything out. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: きれいな花を家で見たいです。一本なら摘んでよいか、触る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園の花を家で見たいので、触る前に一本摘んでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to enjoy these beautiful flowers at home. Before touching them, I would like to check whether I may pick just one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to enjoy the park's flowers at home and ask whether you may pick one before touching it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公園の植栽ですので、ご自身の持ち物ではありません。採ることを認める案内はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: These are the park's plants, so they are not your personal property. Was there any notice allowing you to pick them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。自然を楽しめる場所なら、少し持ち帰ってもよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 採ってよいという案内はなく、自然を楽しむ場所なら少し持ち帰れると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I thought that if it was a place for enjoying nature, I could take a little home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there was no notice allowing picking and that you thought you could take a little home from a place for enjoying nature. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 観察と採取は別です。案内に従い、植えられた花を傷つけないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Observing and collecting are different. Please follow the notices and do not damage the planted flowers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では摘みません。家で見るために写真を撮りたいですが、花壇に入らず通路から撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花は摘まず、家で見るために花壇へ入らず通路から写真を撮りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not pick them. I would like to take photos to look at at home, but I will take them from the path without entering the flower bed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not pick the flowers and want to take photos from the path without entering the flower bed so you can enjoy them at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通行する方の妨げにならず、届く位置から撮ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please take photos from a position you can reach without obstructing people passing by.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近づけない花はズームで見ます。よい写真のために柵を越えたり、枝を引いたりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 近づけない花はズームで見て、撮影のために柵を越えたり枝を引いたりしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use zoom to see flowers I cannot get close to. I will not climb over fences or pull branches to get a good photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will use zoom for flowers you cannot approach and will not cross fences or pull branches to take photos. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。公園の花をその場で楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. Enjoy the park's flowers where they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花は残し、通路から写真だけ撮ります。家に飾る花は、別に店で購入することにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花を残して通路から写真だけ撮り、家に飾る花は店で買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the flowers and only take photos from the path. I will buy flowers for displaying at home separately from a shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the flowers, take only photos from the path, and buy flowers for displaying at home from a shop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。花を大切にしていただきありがとうございます。どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01227-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for taking care of the flowers. Please enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。旅の移動で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 深川で乗り換えます。出発した駅のロッカーの荷物を、ここで受け取れると思っていたので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出発駅のロッカーの荷物を乗り換え駅で受け取れると思っていたので、相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am changing trains in Fukagawa. I thought I could collect the luggage I left in a locker at my departure station here, so I would like some advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought you could collect luggage from a departure-station locker at the station where you are changing trains and would like advice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物は配送を申し込みましたか。それともロッカーに入れて鍵を持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you arrange delivery for your luggage, or did you put it in a locker and keep the key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ロッカーに入れて鍵を持っています。配送は頼んでいません。乗り換え駅へ自動で移ると思ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物はロッカーに入れて鍵を持ち、配送は頼んでいないが自動で乗り換え駅に移ると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put it in a locker and have the key. I did not request delivery. I mistakenly thought it would move automatically to my transfer station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you put the luggage in a locker and have the key, did not request delivery, but thought it would move automatically to the transfer station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 預けた場所で受け取る必要がありますね。預けた駅と場所はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to collect it where you left it. Do you know the station and location where you left it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鍵の札とロッカーの写真があります。駅名も確認できるので、同じ形のロッカーをここで探すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵の札と写真で預けた駅を確認できるため、今いる駅で同じ形のロッカーを探すのはやめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the key tag and a photo of the locker. I can also confirm the station name, so I will stop looking for a similar-looking locker here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you can identify the original station from the key tag and photo, so you will stop looking for the same type of locker at your current station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の駅へ戻る予定を考えましょう。現在の乗車券でどう移動するかは担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us consider a plan for returning to the original station. Please check with the person in charge how to travel using your current ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先の予定に間に合うかだけでなく、戻る経路とロッカーの利用条件も確認します。鍵を誰かへ渡して済ませるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 戻る経路とロッカーの利用条件を確認し、鍵を誰かに渡して受取りを済ませるつもりはないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check not only whether I can make my later plans but also the route back and the locker conditions. I am not planning to solve this by giving the key to someone else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the route back and the locker conditions and do not plan to have someone collect the luggage simply by giving them the key. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の駅へ戻る必要があるので、荷物を取ってからではなく、今のうちに待ち合わせ相手へ予定が変わることを知らせますか。新しい時刻は未定と伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Since you need to return to the original station, would you like to tell the person you are meeting now that your plans will change, rather than waiting until you have retrieved your luggage? You can tell them the new time is still undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、今すぐ戻る必要があることと、新しい待ち合わせ時刻は未定と連絡します。戻る旅程と券の扱いを相談し、荷物を回収したら改めて予定を更新します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収完了を待たず今すぐ相手へ元の駅へ戻る必要と新時刻未定を知らせ、戻る旅程と券を相談して回収後に予定を更新すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will contact them right away to say that I need to return and that the new meeting time is undecided. I will ask about the return journey and ticket arrangements, then update my plans again after collecting the luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that without waiting until collection is complete, you will contact the other person immediately about returning to the original station and the undecided new meeting time, ask about the return journey and ticket, and update plans after collection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。旅程の担当へご案内します。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge of travel arrangements. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。用紙の記入で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you fill out the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この人数欄に家族全員の数を書きましたが、今日の相談人数を書く場所だったか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数欄に家族全員の数を書いたが、今日の相談人数の欄なのか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the total number of my family members in this number-of-people field, but I want to check whether it was meant for the number attending today's consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote the total number of family members in the number-of-people field but want to check whether it is for today's consultation attendees. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 欄の見出しは何と書かれていますか。今日、一緒に相談する方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What is the field heading? Is anyone consulting with you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談者数とあります。今日は私だけです。家族の人数を聞かれていると思って五人と書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見出しは相談者数で、今日は自分一人だが家族の人数だと思って五人と書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says number of people seeking consultation. Today it is just me. I wrote five because I thought it was asking how many people were in my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the heading says number of people seeking consultation and you are alone today, but wrote five thinking it meant your family size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この用紙の「相談者数」は、今回相談する方の人数です。今日はあなた一人なので一人、次の「世帯人数」は別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this form, that field means the number of people seeking advice this time. Since it is just you today, that is one. Let us check the next household-size field separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の欄が世帯人数です。同じ五人を両方に写さず、相談者の欄を一人に訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次の欄が世帯人数なので五人を両方に写さず、相談者数を一人に訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The next field is household size. Rather than copying five into both, I would like to correct the consultation field to one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the next field is household size, so rather than copying five into both, you want to correct the consultation count to one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正方法を担当に確認しましょう。世帯の人数も、ご自身で把握している内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the correction method with the person in charge. Is the household size also something you know yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同居は五人です。今日は来ていない家族も含めた同居人数で、相談する人の数とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同居は五人で、来ていない家族も含むため、今日相談する人の数とは違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Five of us live together. That includes family who are not here today, so it is different from the number seeking advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that five people live together, including family members who are not here, so that is different from today's consultation count. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当の了解が取れたので、相談者欄だけ五人から一人へ訂正しました。世帯欄は五人のままです。二つの欄を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge has agreed, so I have corrected only the consultation field from five to one. The household field remains five. Please compare the two fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、相談者は一人、世帯は五人になっています。世帯の欄まで一人にはしていませんね。ほかの欄も見出しを読んでから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談者欄は一人へ訂正され世帯欄は五人のままと確認し、他の欄も見出しを読んでから記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the consultation count is one and the household size is five. You have not changed the household field to one as well. I will read the headings before filling out the other fields too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the consultation field has been corrected to one while the household field remains five, and say you will read the headings before completing the other fields. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正した欄と、変えずに残した欄を確認できました。この受付票で相談へ進みましょう。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the field we corrected and the one we left unchanged. Let us proceed to the consultation with this reception form. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の書類で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your medical documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の病院の資料をコピーして持ってきました。片面しか写していないので、不足がないか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前の病院の資料を片面だけコピーしたので、不足がないか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought photocopies of documents from my previous hospital. I copied only one side, so I would like to check whether anything is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you copied only one side of the documents from your previous hospital and would like to check whether anything is missing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の書類はお持ちですか。裏にも情報がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the originals? Is there information on the back too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 原本も持っています。裏にも表がありましたが、コピーには入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本も持参しており裏面にも表があるが、コピーには含まれていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the originals as well. There was also a table on the back, but it is not included in the copies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought the originals and there is a table on the back too, which is missing from the copies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 片面のコピーだけを完全な資料として扱わないよう、担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge so that the single-sided copies are not treated as complete documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 原本を見せたいです。裏の表を自分の言葉だけで写し直すと、数値を間違えるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原本を示し、裏の表を自分で写し直すと数値を間違えるかもしれないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to show the originals. If I recreate the table on the back in my own words, I might get the figures wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the originals and say that if you transcribe the table on the back yourself, you might get the figures wrong. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の了解が取れました。原本の裏も複写して、表裏のコピーを受け取ります。原本はその場でお返しする取扱いです。ほかの受診にも使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge has agreed. We will copy the backs of the originals too and accept copies of both sides. We will return the originals to you immediately. Will you use them for another medical visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原本は後で別の受診にも使います。預ける場合は、返してもらえるかを先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本は別の受診にも使うため、預ける場合は返却されるか先に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also use the originals for another medical visit later. If I leave them with you, I would like to ask beforehand whether they will be returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you need the originals for another medical visit and want to ask in advance whether they will be returned if you leave them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 裏面も複写できました。こちらが表裏のコピーで、こちらが返却する原本です。表と裏が両方あるか、一緒に見比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have copied the backs too. Here are the copies of both sides, and here are your originals to take back. Can we compare them together to make sure both front and back are included?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: コピーには表と裏の両方がありますね。原本も受け取りました。数値を自分で書き直さず、両面のコピーを渡して原本は次の受診に持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: コピーに表裏の両方があり原本も受け取ったと確認し、数値を手で書き直さずコピーを渡して原本は次の受診へ持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The copies include both front and back. I have received the originals too. I will give you the double-sided copies rather than rewrite the figures myself, and take the originals to my next medical visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the copies include both sides and that you received the originals. Say you will hand over the copies without rewriting the figures by hand and take the originals to your next medical visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両面のコピーを受け取り、原本をお返ししたことを確認できました。原本はお手元で保管してください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed that we received copies of both sides and returned your originals. Please keep the originals with you. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜に大きな音がして眠れません。隣の部屋だと思いましたが、音の記録をどう説明するか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜の大きな音で眠れず、隣の部屋だと思ったが記録をどう説明するか相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Loud noises at night are keeping me from sleeping. I thought they came from the next room, but I would like advice on how to describe my record of the noise.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that loud noises at night keep you from sleeping and, although you thought they came from the next room, you want advice on explaining your records. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、どこで聞こえましたか。音が出るところを実際に見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and where did you hear them? Did you actually see where the noise came from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜、自分の寝室で聞きました。音の元は見ていません。壁の方向から聞こえただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨夜寝室で壁の方向から音を聞いたが、音の発生源は見ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard it in my bedroom last night. I did not see the source. I only heard it coming from the direction of the wall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you heard the noise from the direction of the wall in your bedroom last night but did not see its source. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 聞こえた方向と、原因を確認したことは別ですね。継続時間はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The direction you heard it from and confirming its cause are separate things. Do you know how long it lasted?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時計を見たのは二回です。その間ずっと鳴っていたとは言えないので、確認した時刻だけ記録しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時計を見た二つの時刻は記録したが、その間ずっと音が続いたとは確認できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I looked at the clock twice. I cannot say it was making noise the whole time between those points, so I only recorded the times I checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you recorded the two times when you checked the clock but cannot confirm the noise continued throughout the interval. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録した事実を担当に伝えてください。管理者へも相談していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the person in charge the facts you recorded. Have you also consulted the building manager?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。隣の人を名指しして注意するのではなく、まず管理者へ場所と時刻を知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理者にはまだ相談しておらず、隣人を名指しせず聞いた場所と時刻から知らせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. Rather than naming the person next door and warning them, I would first like to tell the manager where and when I heard it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not consulted the manager yet and want to begin by reporting the location and times without naming your neighbor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 安全に配慮してご相談ください。現在の危険や急ぎの事情があればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep your safety in mind when seeking advice. Let us know if there is any current danger or urgent circumstance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 寝室で聞いた時刻と音の様子を伝えます。原因や続いた長さは未確認とし、管理者にも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寝室で聞いた時刻と音の様子を示し、原因と継続時間は未確認として管理者にも相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will describe the times I heard it in my bedroom and what it sounded like. I will say the cause and duration are unconfirmed and also consult the manager.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the times and nature of the noise you heard in your bedroom, say its cause and duration are unconfirmed, and explain that you will also consult the manager. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が状況を確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will check the situation. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お手紙の準備で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you prepare your letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 字が小さいと読みにくい親へ手紙を送ります。宛名と中の文を、大きい文字で用意したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい文字を読みづらい親に手紙を送りたいので、大きな文字で手紙と宛名を準備する方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a letter to my parent, who finds small print difficult to read. I would like to prepare both the address and the letter inside in large writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to prepare a letter and its address in large writing for your parent, who finds small print difficult to read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の大きさは決まっていますか。宛名に必要な情報は用意できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you decided on the envelope size? Do you have all the information needed for the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所と名前のメモがあります。文字を大きくしても番地や部屋番号を省かずに書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所と名前のメモを示し、文字を大きくしても番地や部屋番号を省略しないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a note with the address and name. Even with larger writing, I want to include the full street address and room number without leaving anything out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the note with the address and name and say that even with larger writing you will not omit the street address or room number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な情報を読みやすく配置してください。中の文はどのように用意しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please arrange all necessary information so it is easy to read. How will you prepare the letter inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 短い文を大きく印刷します。住所だけ大きくしても中身が読めるようにはならないので、文の文字も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒だけでなく手紙の本文も、短い文章と大きな文字で印刷したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will print short sentences in large type. Making only the address large will not make the contents readable, so I will review the text size of the letter too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to print the letter itself as well as the envelope using short sentences and large type. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手紙と封筒をそれぞれ確認できますね。写真などを入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check the letter and envelope separately, then. Will you enclose any photos or similar items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真は入れません。連絡してほしい電話番号を別行に書き、数字を続けて読みにくくしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真は入れず、連絡先の電話番号を別の行に書いて読みやすくしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not include photos. I will write the phone number I want them to call on a separate line so the digits do not run into the other text and become difficult to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not include photos and want to write your contact phone number on a separate line to make it easy to read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、宛先と封の状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once it is ready, please check the address and that the envelope is properly sealed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所の情報を省かず書き、中の文と電話番号も読みやすく整えます。完成した封筒で発送方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所、本文、電話番号の読みやすさを確認してから封をし、発送方法を相談することを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write the full address and arrange the letter and phone number so they are easy to read too. I would like to ask about mailing options with the finished envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the readability of the address, letter and phone number before sealing the envelope, then ask about mailing options. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備が整いましたらお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it once it is ready. Thank you.
